chunks: And I shall come upon them from the front and behind, right and left; and You will not find among them many who would give thanks.

key_terms.بَيْنِ أَيْدِيهِمْ: From the front / ahead of them
key_terms.لَأَتِيَنَّهُمْ: I shall come upon them / I shall attack them

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about Satan's ability to mislead humans from all directions?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the totality of Iblis's assault on human faculties, yet emphasizes that true success lies in *shukr* (gratitude), which serves as the spiritual shield against his whispers. The phrase 'most of them' (*aktharuhum*) is interpreted by scholars like Al-Tabarsi to indicate that while the majority may succumb due to heedlessness, a distinct minority will attain salvation through conscious resistance and divine grace.
